title: Chapter 6679: The Heart Wished It So

Chapter 6679: The Heart Wished It So

Chapter 6679: The Heart Wished It So

Ghost Edge appeared capable of decapitating immortals. Bao Pu, once again, had a taste of his weakness compared to the real masters.

He realized how truly dreadful primordial immortals were after seeing their final moves.

“A weapon and a legacy.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Boom!” Evil Transformation made his move. The battlefield exploded but not in the same destructive manner as the summoning of Ghost Edge.

The stars within Evil Transformation detonated and returned to the primordial. A light replaced Evil Transformation’s astral form.

“Primordial Aspects Horn.” An orderly voice came from the light, commanding the initiation of epoch and worlds.

Some visions displayed utmost goodness and purity - angels. More held boundless knowledge - celestial runes and sigils. Another contained infinite love, spreading to other epochs.

They represented the ultimate manifestation of the beauties in the mortal world. Once pushed to the extreme, they contained unimaginable powers and could birth immortals.

“One wish.” Evil Transformation combined the visions into a final wish in the shape of a horn.

“Crackle!” It seemed this wish touched the high heaven, resulting in thunderous explosions. The radiant wish rushed toward Li Qiye.

“Death of the High Heaven!” Fiendish Ground also swung the blade at the same time. Everything turned dark instantly.

Spectators got the impression that this blade could cut through the high heaven.

“Rumble!” Eventually, the darkness subsided.

Everyone saw a pulsing figure within the primordial light, pierced by both the horn and the blade.

“How does it feel to break a primordial body?” Li Qiye asked with a smile.

“Good.” Evil Transformation responded.

“A legacy artifact and a primordial source... I see.” Fiendish Ground said softly.

“Do I need a legacy artifact to become a primordial immortal?” Li Qiye answered with a question.

“It is not on you.” Evil Transformation sensed something different.

“You should have known long ago.” Li Qiye smiled.

“The roots should be within you.” They suspected the roots of the primordial tree should be within Li Qiye.

However, they pierced through his outer shell and found this to be false.

“It never was, not at the beginning or any point.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“The primordial will is not your true fate?” Evil Transformation found this unbelievable: “How did you become a primordial immortal?”

Both innate and cultivated primordial immortals must have a legacy. They believed his legacy might be the primordial will - the most profound manifestation of primordial essence.

“Because my heart wished it so.” Li Qiye said.

“Impossible.” Evil Transformation didn’t buy this since it broke a fundamental rule. Becoming an immortal was one thing but a primordial immortal?

“I don’t need to prove anything.” Li Qiye smiled before pulling the horn and the blade out of his body.

“Crack!” His primordial shell shattered but it didn’t affect him. Once they were removed, the shell came together again.

“We killed nothing, this shell isn’t your body.” Evil Transformation complained.

“My body has always been made of flesh and blood, it’s a misunderstanding on your part.” Li Qiye smiled.

They assumed Li Qiye had something special - a primordial shell based on the primordial will. This made him virtually unkillable.

Thus, they used their most fundamental essences and legacy artifacts to pierce him. Other weapons stood no chance.

They found that despite having a primordial shell, Li Qiye’s main body was still regular.
